task: mobile org switch and deep-link test suite; audit tests in services/api/tests/ for organization and workspace operations, cross-organization switching, invitation acceptance deep links.

verified_source_anchors.description: Reads capability from JSON payload or X-Family-Invitation-Token header, strictly barring URL-based token delivery.
Non-mutating preview returning metadata without consuming or auditing single-use invitation capability.
Rejects invitation token in URL path with HTTP 410 Gone and does not echo secret.
Returns counts of user-scoped folders, channels, and notes without cross-tenant disclosures.
Enforces user-scoped ownership guard for workspace folder resources.
Sets Cache-Control: no-store, private and Vary: Authorization, X-CLARA-Profile-Context to prevent multi-tenant cache poisoning.
Resolves active context safely with automatic fallback and reset_required on stale/foreign context header.
Mobile summary route returning API health, quick links, and role-scoped feature flags.
Parses public capability tokens from approved canonical HTTPS links while rejecting malicious schemes and foreign domains.
Presentation mode switching is strictly a client layout context and never overrides backend RBAC.

interface_assumptions: Invitation capability tokens are opaque 32-512 character strings transmitted via JSON body or request headers (X-Organization-Invitation-Token, X-Family-Invitation-Token).
Deep links in mobile and web must be validated against HTTPS canonical hosts (theclaracare.com, www.theclaracare.com) or approved native scheme (clara://).
Accepting an invitation via URL path (POST /invitations/{token}/accept) is permanently deprecated and responds with HTTP 410 Gone without echoing secret.
Context switching endpoints must set Cache-Control: no-store, private and Vary: Authorization, X-CLARA-Org-Context / X-CLARA-Profile-Context.
Stale or unpermitted organization context headers fail safe with reset_required=True, preventing cross-tenant leakage or internal server errors.
Presentation mode changes (Personal, Clinical, Research, Admin) alter only client layout and navigation, leaving backend RBAC strictly enforced.

tests_run.command: CLARA_TEST_DATABASE_URL="sqlite+pysqlite:////dev/shm/clara_test_a07.db" python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mobile_org_switching_and_deep_links.py tests/test_workspace_endpoints.py tests/test_family_circle_v2.py tests/test_auth_me_and_mobile_summary.py tests/test_auth_and_rbac.py tests/test_auth_security_hardening.py tests/test_profile_context_notifications.py tests/test_rbac_profile_scope_idor.py tests/hardening/test_authz_under_privileged.py

rollback_steps: git commit -m 'revert(ph04-a07): rollback mobile org switch and deep-link test suite'
